notes.title: Action - Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34509723/d81acda1841e991b351990432a51b2876fc5a83e.jpg[/img]

Hello friends! In connection with Halloween, a 60% discount is set for 7th Sector game, and my other projects! Along with this, an interesting competition for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077520/The_Light_Remake/]The Light Remake[/url] game  starts, in which you can win a cash prize, and a key from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/466500/35MM/?curator_clanid=33976621]35MM[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/749250/7th_Sector/?curator_clanid=33976621]7th Sector[/url], if you do not already have them.

To participate in the competition you need:
- repost on [url=https://vk.com/indiegameferum?w=wall-56446165_5690%2Fall]VK[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/noskovfe]Facebook[/url]
- update the game The Light Remake to the latest version and find some secrets: 4 TVs with frames from different horror films (you can interact with TVs, they will need to be turned on)
 - take screenshots of TVs, send me a PM in [url=https://vk.com/ferumss]VK[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/noskovfe]Facebook[/url] or by mail NoskovFe@mail.ru
- also, in the message, write which films you identified on the screens (films titles)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/0f72dde95fe089cc9ef1d2ca502c36fb53bca5f0.jpg[/img]

The first 3 participants who send correct answers will receive a cash prize of 10, 20, 30 dollars and a key from 35MM or 7th Sector (console version of 7th Sector also). As a bonus, the leading participant will also receive an electronic version of the [url=https://ridero.ru/books/35_mm/]book[/url] based on the 35MM game.

The competition will run until November 2. The results will be published on the The Light Remake game page, in the VK group and Facebook after the Halloween sale on Steam.

notes.title: 7th Sector - Free DLC
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34509723/5ed500b63f8fd48f57a08cc14c6f7643a29b723e.jpg[/img]

Hello! A contest is announced in connection with the release of free DLC  "Museum"  for the 7th Sector game! DLC is not a big game, but it contains some details and events. In a specific location  you will find an encrypted audio message that you will need to decode. The decoded message is a phrase, that you must send me in a personal VK or email. The first three people who sent the right decoded message will receive a cash prize:

50$, 24$ и 10$ 

To enter the contest you need:

-Download "Museum" DLC on Steam (release is plan for August 2)
- Find, decode a message and send by mail or in a personal  VK
- Make a repost of VK post  and join the group Indie Game

 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KdcXx4sDd1Q
 You will find the link to the group in VK under YouTube video
Mail noskovfe@mail.ru

_____________
Guys, according to the results of received messages, the competition found its winners and was completed! I will not publish the answer to the puzzle  yet. Thanks to everyone for participating!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34509723/4472f0c8db97f78cf6b43cab71f77ada703a27bb.jpg[/img]

Fixed several gameplay and graphical bugs. Fixed the error of saving the controller selection in the menu, closed some areas where the character fell into textures, solved the problem with the invisible wall at the Chase level, fixed the problem with the container blocking the path at the Tower level, etc.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34509723/4472f0c8db97f78cf6b43cab71f77ada703a27bb.jpg[/img]

Hello! Update 1.0.1   

- Fixed a bug with going beyond the location
- The control of the drone with  using the gamepad is smoother.
- Changed the toy car control from the cross to the left stick.
- Added control map with gamepad (main buttons)
- On some puzzles, the pause between the buttons is reduced
- MAYBE, fixed bug with invisible people, casting shadows. I could not repeat the bug, so there are no guarantees.
- Fixed a bug with the achievement  "Chronicle" when collecting all the pictures in the menu
